channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Warning · Devils River at Bakers Crossing 19N Of Comstock
item.description: Flood Warning issued November 11 at 8:33AM CST until November 11 at 10:30PM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX. In effect until Nov 11, 10:30 PM CT. Areas: Val Verde. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
